projects.title: DEALR – Deals App | UI/UX Case Study
projects.description: A location-based deals platform helping urban explorers discover exclusive 2-for-1 dining, café, nightlife, and leisure experiences with seamless digital voucher redemption.
projects.problem: Exploring new dining and entertainment venues in urban cities can be financially daunting and search-intensive. Traditional voucher and discount apps suffer from clunky barcode interfaces, expired or complicated redemption rules, opaque discount conditions, and visual clutter that discourages spontaneous social outings.
projects.solution: Engineered DEALR — an intuitive, location-aware mobile experience and web companion that curates verified 2-for-1 offers across premier restaurants, specialty cafés, cocktail lounges, and weekend leisure hotspots. Designed a modern social discovery feed, map-integrated radius search, interactive venue profiles with live menus, and frictionless 1-tap digital voucher activation now published on Google Play and Apple App Store.
projects.caseStudy:
### Product Overview and Value Proposition

**DEALR** is a location-based deals platform designed to help urban consumers discover exclusive 2-for-1 offers at top restaurants, specialty cafés, cocktail lounges, and weekend entertainment hotspots. The core mission of the platform is to make exploring new culinary and social venues genuinely affordable by enabling users to unlock nearby deals, activate verified digital vouchers, and enjoy shared experiences while paying for only one person.

As the Lead UI/UX Designer, I architected the end-to-end design system and user experience across both the native mobile applications (iOS and Android) and responsive web touchpoints, ensuring that locating, evaluating, and redeeming offers is instantaneous, social, and friction-free.

![DEALR App Cover & Visual Direction](/uploads/dealr-hero.png)

![DEALR Value Proposition & Brand Mission](/uploads/dealr-module-1.png)

---

### User Research & Problem Identification

Urban dining and nightlife exploration frequently involves prohibitive dining costs, fragmented discount aggregators, and cumbersome redemption procedures. Through in-depth user interviews and behavioral mapping, three key user pain points were uncovered:

1. **Voucher Skepticism & Complicated Terms:** Users distrust traditional discount apps because of obscure restrictions, blackout dates, or humiliating redemption steps at the counter.
2. **Choice Fatigue in Dense Metro Areas:** Existing directories overwhelm users with infinite uncurated lists without intuitive radius calibration or contextual recommendations.
3. **Friction-Heavy In-Store Redemption:** Staff confusion and slow checkout validation discourage spontaneous adoption.

![Research & Persona Exploration](/uploads/dealr-module-2.png)

![User Journey & Pain Point Analysis](/uploads/dealr-module-3.png)

---

### Spatial Discovery & Proximity-Aware Deal Architecture

To minimize time-to-decision, DEALR implements a fluid, proximity-aware exploration engine with live interactive radius filtering and curated vibe-based tagging.

- **Dynamic Radius Dial:** Users can seamlessly toggle between Walking Distance (500m), Neighborhood (2km), and Metro (10km+).
- **Curated Category Tabs:** Direct access to "2-for-1 Main Courses", "Craft Cocktails & Happy Hour", "Artisanal Coffee & Bakeries", and "Weekend Leisure".
- **Real-Time Availability:** Clear visual indicators displaying venue open hours, remaining daily voucher quotas, and walking ETA.

![Location Discovery & Radius Filter System](/uploads/dealr-module-4.png)

![Category Navigation & Instant Search](/uploads/dealr-module-5.png)

![Curated 2-for-1 Offer Cards](/uploads/dealr-module-6.png)

---

### Venue Immersion & 1-Tap Redemption Flow

When users tap on a venue card, they transition into an immersive visual profile designed to showcase the authentic ambiance, signature dishes, and exact promotional terms before arriving.

- **Editorial Imagery & Storytelling:** Highlighting signature menu items and interior aesthetic to build trust.
- **Transparent Terms of Use:** Clear, upfront terms (e.g., "Valid on all à la carte main courses, Monday to Thursday") with zero hidden fine print.
- **1-Tap Digital Voucher Pass:** A prominent interactive activation screen featuring a fraud-resistant animated visual timestamp that waitstaff can verify in 2 seconds without requiring POS hardware integration.

![Venue Showcase & Atmosphere Overview](/uploads/dealr-module-7.png)

![Menu Highlights & Promotion Terms](/uploads/dealr-module-8.png)

![1-Tap Secure Voucher Redemption](/uploads/dealr-module-9.png)

![Real-Time Savings Tracker & User Profile](/uploads/dealr-module-10.png)

---

### Design System, Typography & Multi-Platform Polish

A bold, high-contrast visual system was developed to guarantee readability across bright outdoor daylight and dimly lit evening venues. Tactile cards, deep dark-mode support, micro-interactions, and accessible typography establish a premium, playful brand presence.

![Color Palette & Accessible Typography](/uploads/dealr-module-11.png)

![Component Library & Micro-interactions](/uploads/dealr-module-12.png)

![Dark Mode & High-Contrast Visuals](/uploads/dealr-module-13.png)

![Onboarding & Social Experience Flow](/uploads/dealr-module-14.png)

![Comprehensive Device Mockups & App Experience](/uploads/dealr-module-15.png)

![Cross-Platform App Store & Play Store Ecosystem](/uploads/dealr-module-16.png)

---

### Live Application & Credits

The **DEALR** mobile app is actively published and live for download on both major mobile platforms:
- **Google Play Store:** [Download DEALR on Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=de.dealrapp.app&hl=en)
- **Apple App Store:** [Download DEALR on iOS App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dealr-app/id6761794996)
- **Behance Portfolio:** [Explore on Behance](https://www.behance.net/gallery/258846395/DEALR-Deals-App-UIUX-Case-Study)

projects.title: SOLÉA® — Hotel Booking Website Design
projects.description: A luxury boutique hotel and resort booking platform designed with editorial elegance, spatial minimalism, and an immersive reservation journey.
projects.problem: Modern luxury hospitality websites frequently struggle with cluttered layouts, disjointed reservation funnels, and lack of spatial storytelling. High-end guests seeking bespoke resort experiences encounter generic booking grids with friction-heavy guest calibration and ambiguous pricing breakdowns.
projects.solution: Engineered SOLÉA® — a boutique hotel and luxury resort booking web ecosystem designed with editorial sophistication, tactile typography, and minimal interaction friction. Crafted an immersive visual showcase with interactive suite preview tours, real-time date and guest calibration, transparent amenity breakdowns, and a seamless 3-step high-conversion checkout flow.
projects.caseStudy:
### Product Overview and Architecture

SOLÉA® is a premier luxury hospitality and boutique resort booking web platform designed to elevate the online reservation experience for discerning international travelers. Instead of generic booking grids and cluttered forms, the platform merges high-fashion editorial aesthetics with intuitive user-centric booking flows.

The product architecture focuses on three foundational pillars:
- Immersive Spatial Storytelling: High-resolution full-bleed visuals, dynamic lighting moodboards, and virtual suite walkthroughs that evoke the tranquil luxury of the resort.
- Streamlined Reservation Engine: A frictionless date, room tier, and guest calibration modal with transparent real-time pricing and no hidden booking fees.
- Curated Concierge Add-ons: Contextual discovery of bespoke dining experiences, private yacht excursions, and wellness spa packages integrated directly into the reservation workflow.

---

### Step 1: Research, Brand Persona & Spatial Strategy

#### Target Audience and Emotional Persona
Luxury resort guests prioritize exclusivity, visual serenity, and seamless digital interactions. Through user interviews and competitor benchmarking, we identified that traditional hotel aggregators create cognitive fatigue through excessive banners, countdown timers, and dense data tables. SOLÉA replaces this anxiety with a calming, tactile digital atmosphere.

#### Design Philosophy & Token Architecture
The visual identity relies on warm editorial earth tones (#F8F8F5 canvas, deep espresso borders, and sunlit terracotta accents) paired with refined serif typography and modernist sans-serif utility labels. Every UI token was designed in Figma with comprehensive auto-layout and responsive breakpoints.

![SOLÉA Brand Persona & Typography Strategy](/uploads/solea-module-1.png)

---

### Step 2: The Editorial Hero & Immersive Discovery Engine

#### Cinematic Hero Showcase
The landing experience greets guests with an evocative full-width cinematic view of the resort, paired with an elegant floating reservation bar. Guests can immediately specify arrival dates, duration, suite preference, and guest count with real-time room availability feedback.

#### Curated Destination Dossiers
Beyond static room photos, SOLÉA presents contextual dossiers for each destination—detailing local climate, private transit options, Michelin-starred culinary offerings, and seasonal retreat highlights to immerse travelers before they book.

![SOLÉA Luxury Editorial Hero & Booking Discovery](/uploads/solea-module-2.png)

---

### Step 3: Interactive Suite Dossier & Spatial Tour

#### Dynamic Suite Customizer
Guests can effortlessly explore suites across categories—from Oceanview Villas to Cliffside Penthouses. Each suite view details floorplans, panoramic terrace views, private pool availability, and curated bath amenities.

#### Real-Time Pricing Transparency
SOLÉA eliminates surprise resort fees at checkout. All pricing updates dynamically as guests toggle room upgrades, flexible cancellation guarantees, and inclusive breakfast packages.

![SOLÉA Suite Customizer & Real-Time Availability](/uploads/solea-module-3.png)

---

### Step 4: Frictionless 3-Step Booking & Guest Concierge Checkout

#### Step-by-Step Reservation Funnel
The checkout process is compressed into three clear, distraction-free stages:
- Stage 1: Room & Experience Personalization (select bedding preferences, private airport pickup, and dietary requirements).
- Stage 2: Guest Details & Loyalty Pass (seamless one-click autofill with Apple Pay, Google Pay, and encrypted card storage).
- Stage 3: Instant Digital Confirmation & Wallet Pass (instant confirmation with offline wallet ticket and concierge chat access).

![SOLÉA Frictionless Checkout & Guest Experience](/uploads/solea-module-4.png)

---

### Step 5: Responsive Design System, Typography & Micro-Interactions

#### Fluid Desktop to Mobile Adaptation
Whether browsing on a 4K studio display or an iPhone on the move, SOLÉA's interface maintains generous whitespace, tactile tap targets, and smooth scroll animations without layout shifting.

#### Micro-Interactions & Tactile Polish
Subtle hover states on suite cards, interactive date sliders, and magnetic buttons guide user focus naturally toward the primary reservation call-to-actions, elevating the perceived value of the resort brand.

![SOLÉA Full Responsive Design System & Component Library](/uploads/solea-module-5.png)

---

### End-to-End Experience Summary

1. Visual Hook: The traveler lands on SOLÉA's editorial hero and selects their desired retreat dates.
2. Exploration: The traveler explores suite galleries, floorplans, and seasonal culinary highlights.
3. Customization: The guest adds private cabana access and bespoke wellness services to their reservation.
4. Seamless Checkout: A minimal, 3-step payment flow with full pricing transparency completes the booking in under 90 seconds.
5. Post-Booking Care: Instant digital pass with dedicated direct concierge WhatsApp communication is delivered immediately.

projects.title: This is Mauritius — Travel & Lifestyle App
projects.description: A seamless mobile travel and lifestyle platform helping international tourists and locals discover curated venues, activities, and hidden island gems.
projects.problem: Tourists visiting Mauritius struggled to find authentic local activities beyond traditional resort confines. Information was fragmented across outdated blogs, slow hotel brochures, and scattered tour operators.
projects.solution: Created an all-in-one destination companion app featuring curated category filters (beaches, waterfalls, restaurants, nightspots, cultural tours), offline interactive maps, personalized itinerary generators, and frictionless direct booking.
projects.caseStudy:
### Product Overview and Architecture

This is Mauritius is a comprehensive mobile travel and lifestyle application designed to streamline island exploration for international travelers and local residents alike.

---

### Step 1: Contextual Onboarding and Travel Style

#### Traveler Profiling
When opening the application for the first time, users choose between international traveler mode and local resident mode. International visitors receive currency conversion tools and offline navigation prompts, while local residents see weekend cultural festivals and newly opened dining spots.

#### Offline Map Download
The application offers an optional offline map package covering the entire island under forty-five megabytes. This allows travelers to navigate scenic coastal drives and mountain trails without relying on expensive cellular roaming.

---

### Step 2: Island Discovery and Dynamic Feed

#### Category Exploration
Travelers can explore curated categories including secluded beaches, rainforest waterfalls, heritage rum distilleries, and catamaran excursions. Each listing includes verified photos, admission details, and recommended visiting times.

#### Live Weather and Coastal Conditions
An integrated weather strip provides real-time marine and weather conditions across the northern, southern, eastern, and western coasts, helping visitors choose the best beach based on current wind and sunshine.

---

### Step 3: Smart Itinerary Planning and Bookings

#### Algorithmic Route Clustering
Users can add multiple destinations to a custom itinerary. The application automatically clusters activities geographically to minimize travel time along winding coastal roads.

#### Direct Host Communication and Reservations
Listings provide one-tap links to connect with local excursion operators and reserve dining tables directly via WhatsApp or online booking.

projects.title: Memorial Moments Magazine — Storytelling App
projects.description: An emotional storytelling and digital magazine mobile application crafted to preserve, cherish, and celebrate legacy family memories and life milestones.
projects.problem: Valuable family histories, memoirs, and life milestone photos are often buried in scattered chat threads and disorganized cloud drives, losing their emotional narrative over time.
projects.solution: Developed an editorial magazine format for mobile devices. Families collaboratively compile photos, voice memos, and written reflections into beautifully typeset, printable, and shareable digital magazines that honor cherished memories forever.
projects.caseStudy:
### Product Overview and Architecture

Memorial Moments Magazine is a collaborative mobile publishing application that turns family stories, voice memos, and archival photos into beautifully typeset digital magazines and heirloom print keepsakes.

---

### Step 1: Story Room Creation and Invitations

#### Creating a Family Chronicle
A family organizer creates a dedicated publication room for a milestone anniversary, a tribute, or a family heritage archive. The creator sets privacy permissions and invites relatives through secure invite links.

#### Multi-Generational Contribution
Family members of all ages can contribute through voice recordings, scanned photographs, or written recollections. Audio recordings are automatically transcribed into readable paragraphs, making participation simple for older relatives.

---

### Step 2: Automated Typesetting and Reading Experience

#### Intelligent Layout Engine
The application automatically formats contributed stories and photos into balanced magazine spreads with pull quotes, full-bleed images, and chronological dates, eliminating the need for graphic design expertise.

#### Interactive Digital Reader
Family members can read the completed publication on smartphones or tablets with tactile page-curl animations and tap to hear original voice recordings embedded directly alongside quotes.

---

### Step 3: Heirloom Keepsake Printing

#### Print Pre-Flight Checks
The system inspects vintage photos to ensure high resolution and validates page margins for hardcover bookbinding.

#### Direct Home Delivery
Organizers can order archival hardcover or softcover editions shipped directly to relatives across different cities in a single checkout.

projects.title: LoveKonnection — Event-Driven Dating App
projects.description: An event-driven dating app replacing mindless swiping with real-world connections through curated events and verified check-ins.
projects.problem: Modern dating apps have trapped users in endless loops of swiping fatigue, superficial ghosting, and low conversion to real-world dates. Users spent hours per day matching with people they would never actually meet in person.
projects.solution: LoveKonnection bridges the digital-to-physical gap with an event-centric paradigm. Users discover curated, interest-based social events, RSVP, and connect with other attendees before, during, and after the event. Designed a full 3-role ecosystem: User (mobile), Organizer (mobile & tablet), and Super Admin (web dashboard) across 60+ responsive screens.
projects.caseStudy:
### Product Overview and Architecture

LoveKonnection is an event-driven social dating application designed to solve dating app fatigue. Instead of endless digital swiping, the platform connects people through curated offline social gatherings such as wine tastings, speed dating, rooftop mixers, and activity workshops.

The product ecosystem connects three main roles:
- Single Attendees: Browse curated gatherings, reserve tickets, check in at venues, and connect with people they meet.
- Event Organizers: Publish local experiences, scan guest tickets at the door, and monitor room capacity.
- Safety Administrators: Supervise user verification, resolve dispute reports, and ensure community standards.

---

### Step 1: Onboarding and Identity Verification

#### Welcome and Brand Introduction
The welcome screen introduces the core philosophy of LoveKonnection: real chemistry happens in real life. First-time visitors view a brief preview of upcoming community mixers and begin registration with their mobile phone number.

#### Phone Authentication and Access Control
To protect the community from spam accounts and repeat offenders, every member verifies their account using their mobile phone number. A six-digit SMS code confirms their identity immediately. If delivery is delayed, members can request a resend through WhatsApp or a short automated phone call.

#### Biometric Verification and Anti-Catfishing
To ensure the person arriving at an event matches their profile pictures, users complete a quick front-camera verification check. The system analyzes live facial landmarks to confirm authenticity. Approved members receive a verified checkmark on their profile, while uncertain submissions are routed to human reviewers for confirmation within fifteen minutes.

#### Lifestyle and Activity Calibration
Members customize their matchmaking preferences through interactive topic tags. Users choose their dating intentions, favorite weekend activities, and preferred search radius. The application uses this information to suggest relevant upcoming gatherings without subjecting members to tedious questionnaires.

---

### Step 2: Event Discovery and Schedule Exploration

#### The Event Radar Feed
The discovery feed serves as the central hub of the application. Members can browse upcoming gatherings filtered by date, neighborhood, or event style. Each card shows the venue neighborhood, ticket cost, schedule highlights, and a real-time attendance balance meter showing male and female registration ratios so attendees know the crowd will be balanced.

#### Interactive City Map
Users can toggle from the card feed into an interactive map view to discover gatherings happening near their home, workplace, or hotel. Tapping any map pin reveals a preview card with distance and opening hours.

#### Event Dossier and Evening Itinerary
Tapping an event opens a full dossier outlining the exact timeline for the evening. For example, guests see that welcome drinks begin at 7:30 PM, conversation rotations start at 8:15 PM, and open social mingling continues from 9:30 PM onward. This transparency eases social anxiety by letting attendees know exactly what to expect.

---

### Step 3: Ticketing, Digital Passes, and Pre-Event Lounge

#### One-Tap Ticket Reservation
Guests can reserve their spot using Apple Pay, Google Pay, or a credit card in a streamlined checkout flow. When a user begins checkout, their seat is reserved for five minutes to prevent duplicate bookings during high-demand releases.

#### Anti-Fraud Digital Pass
Upon booking, attendees receive a digital entry pass stored directly within the application. The pass features a rolling dynamic QR code that refreshes every thirty seconds alongside an animated watermark, preventing ticket duplication or scalping.

#### The 24-Hour Pre-Event Lounge
Exactly twenty-four hours before the event begins, confirmed ticket holders gain access to an exclusive pre-event lounge. Attendees can answer lighthearted icebreaker polls and see previews of verified members who will be in the room. Direct messaging remains locked until in-person check-in to preserve the excitement of meeting face-to-face first.

---

### Step 4: In-Venue Physical Event Experience

#### Door Check-In
When an attendee arrives at the venue, the event host scans their dynamic QR code using the organizer tablet application. The attendee phone provides a gentle haptic confirmation and immediately switches the screen into Live Event Mode.

#### Live Event Mode and Conversation Prompts
During the gathering, the application acts as an unobtrusive wingman. If a conversation pauses, tapping the conversation prompt button presents thought-provoking questions tailored to both participants based on their shared interests.

#### Discrete Mutual Spark Selection
Throughout the evening, attendees can privately mark their connection with people they met. Users select whether each person was a romantic spark, a friendly connection, or neutral. No one is ever notified of a one-sided choice, eliminating any chance of in-person awkwardness or rejection.

---

### Step 5: Post-Event Connections and Direct Chat

#### The Morning Connection Reveal
At ten o'clock the morning after the event, attendees receive a notification that their connection results are ready. If two people mutually selected each other, a celebratory screen reveals their match along with shared talking points from the night before.

#### Direct Messaging and Date Recommendations
Matched pairs can begin chatting immediately within a safe, dedicated conversation window. The chat interface includes convenient buttons suggesting popular public coffee shops and venues midway between both users to help them easily plan their first individual date.

---

### End-to-End Experience Summary

1. Account Setup: The user downloads the app, verifies their phone number, and completes biometric selfie verification.
2. Preferences: The user chooses their dating intentions, preferred social activities, and distance radius.
3. Event Discovery: The user browses the radar, finds a rooftop mixer, and checks the attendance balance meter.
4. Booking: The user reviews the evening schedule, locks their seat for five minutes, and purchases a ticket.
5. Anticipation: Twenty-four hours prior, the pre-event lounge opens with community polls and attendee previews.
6. Arrival: The host scans the user's dynamic QR ticket at the door, unlocking live event mode.
7. Interaction: The user mingles, uses conversation prompt cards, and privately marks people they enjoyed meeting.
8. Morning Results: At ten in the morning, mutual sparks are revealed with zero awkwardness.
9. First Date: The matched pair chats and schedules their first individual date at a suggested midway cafe.
